name: io.github.SokolskyNikita/annas-mcp
title: Anna's Archive
description: Search Anna's Archive for books and papers (by title, author or DOI) and download the file you pick.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_ACCOUNT_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Your aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in Anna's Archive session. Needed for everything.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Anna's Archive API key. Needed for downloads.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_DOWNLOAD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute folder for downloaded files. Needed for downloads.
